outputs.justification: GEO series page is publicly available and lists the study title, samples and platform; supplementary / processed files and links to raw data are provided on the GEO record. ([ncbi.nlm.nih.gov](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE273732))

GEO series page is public, shows study metadata, sample list and provides processed supplementary files and links to raw data in SRA. ([ncbi.nlm.nih.gov](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE94136))

GEO SuperSeries page is public, lists constituent SubSeries and samples and provides download links (including a TAR of raw/processed files and links to SRA). ([ncbi.nlm.nih.gov](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE168222))

The DOI is registered and the dataset is listed on institutional/aggregator pages (University of Edinburgh Research Explorer) as a Zenodo dataset (record 15754236) containing the source data for the figures. (Direct Zenodo page accessible at the DOI/Zenodo record). ([research.ed.ac.uk](https://www.research.ed.ac.uk/en/datasets/tet-knockout-cells-transit-between-pluripotent-states-and-exhibit?utm_source=openai))
